title: Ku Hlongorisa eHubyeni
intro: Eka tiphaseji ta matimba, munhu wa xiyimo xa le henhla u sungule ku navela nandza loyi ku saseka ka yena a ku ri ka misava yin’wana. Ku navela loku ku yise eka nxaxamelo wa swiendlakalo leswi a swi ta ringa vutshembeki, swi paluxa mintiyiso leyi fihliweke, naswona eku heteleleni swi tiyisekisa ku pfumala nandzu ka nandza.
clues: A ndzi tshama etikweni ra Nayili, exigodlhweni lexi nga ni nkucetelo lowukulu.
Jaha rin’wana ri nghene endlwini ya mina, kutani vukona bya rona byi pfilunganye misava ya mina.
Ndzi ringetile ku n’wi kanganyisa, kambe yena u lave vutumbelo eka Hosi ya yena.
Ndzi handzule nguvu ya yena endzhaku, kambe vumbhoni byi kombetela eka vuxisi bya mina.
Leswaku ndzi miyeta ku hleva ka vavasati va xiyimo xa le henhla, ndzi va rhambile enhlengeletanweni kutani ndzi va veka swilo leswi karihaka emavokweni ya vona.
Eku heteleleni, ndzi pfumerile xihoxo xa mina erivaleni, ndzi pfumela ntiyiso emahlweni ka hosi.

U ringetile ku dlaya Muprofeta Musa
A a tivula xikwembu xa xisati
U ake xihondzo leswaku a tlhontlha Allah
U rhangele vuthu ro lwisana na Makkah
trial.answer: U ringete ku kanganyisa Muprofeta Yusuf

location.answer: Xikipa lexi handzuriweke ku suka endzhaku

options: U pfumerile a tlhela a pfumela ntiyiso

outcome.answer: U pfumerile a tlhela a pfumela ntiyiso

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
